About us · Team

The project team

A multidisciplinary team with experience in eye health, visual rehabilitation, digital accessibility, technology, education and project management, working together with people with low vision.

Scientific leadership and coordination

Day-to-day coordination is led by the University Vision Centre (CUV), which ensures the coherence of all actions, monitors the work plan and integrates the contributions of the whole team.

  • Dr. Lluís Pérez Mañá

    Principal investigator

    Lecturer · Faculty of Optics and Optometry of Terrassa (UPC) · CUV

    Optometrist specialising in low vision and visual rehabilitation, with more than fifteen years of clinical experience with people with low vision and an established track record in university research and teaching. He leads the project scientifically and oversees the suitability of its content.

    • FUTUR profile (UPC)
    • CUV staff

Technical and digital accessibility team

  • AM

    Antonio Moisés Funes Martín

    Digital accessibility and assistive technology expert

    Associació Discapacitat Visual Catalunya: B1+B2+B3

    He has in-depth knowledge of the WCAG standards and of good practice in accessible content. He works as an employment counsellor and assistive technology specialist, and handles accessibility requests at the association. His input is key to making the platform genuinely usable.

    • B1+B2+B3 association website

Participating organisations

  • University Vision Centre (CUV-UPC)

    Coordinating organisation. Faculty of Optics and Optometry of Terrassa, Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya.

    CUV website

  • Associació Discapacitat Visual Catalunya: B1+B2+B3

    Partner organisation. Lived experience and validation of the platform's social value.

    Association website

  • Fundació Punt de Vista

    Partner organisation. Expertise in accessibility and inclusive design, and dissemination through its communication team.

    Foundation website

  • Official College of Opticians and Optometrists of Catalonia (COOOC)

    Collaborator. The professional body for optics and optometry in Catalonia. It hosted the November 2026 co-creation sessions at its headquarters.

    COOOC website
